headline: #236 IS DONE AND ON MAIN, #235 is closed, and #252 is answered with evidence rather than inference. Three PRs merged in sequence: #255 (the 35-commit guardrail sweep everything was stacking on), #258 (the first figma/snapshot.json) and #259 (carriers ship only the runtime they reach). check:figma-drift has now run against real state for the first time in the project's history and is LIVE on main — plain run exits 1 with a real verdict instead of 2 'no snapshot yet', and --ci exits 0 because lastPush is null so every item is drift a push explains. It reports 475 items (62 missing, 35 extra, 378 changed) and 419 of those are metadata: 251 scopes, 121 hiddenFromPublishing, 47 description. Real value drift is a handful of named tokens. It names #252 exactly: color/surface/page [Dark] should alias primitive.color.neutral.black and Figma has it on color/neutral/white. Figma's Dark mode is holding Light's values, every staging variable carries path=null so the file has never received a push, and therefore scripts/build-figma-model.mjs is CORRECT and must not be touched — the fix is pnpm figma:push.
next: #252's fix, now fully unblocked: pnpm figma:push against staging 2VgBbVpKiDnu0aftJEVyBQ (read the dry-run plan first), then re-snapshot with the desktop plugin and re-run check:figma-drift. Expect near-zero afterwards. Do NOT patch build-figma-model.mjs — the drift report proves it is already right

THE BIGGEST DESIGNER-FACING WIN, still never run: FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN=<token> pnpm figma:links --dev-resources --dry-run, then without --dry-run. Attaches 'HDS source' and 'HDS story' dev resources to all 44 mapped nodes, and since #259 set storybookUrl those point at rendered stories instead of raw GitHub. One command, needs file_dev_resources:read+write

Drawing the remaining 40 (41 missing minus StatusDot) is now fully unblocked — #235 ratified AND the snapshot exists. Follow figma/COMPONENT-DRAWING-RECIPE.md. Order: Tier 1 Icon/Token/Text; Tier 2 the date/time family then the overlays; Tier 3 the rest, StackedCardRail and CinematicLink last (#133 may delete them)

#257 — Radio animates backgroundColor/borderColor to var() strings framer-motion cannot interpolate, so the colour transition silently never runs while scale in the same object does. Fix by driving colour from CSS variants; add a gate, because the only symptom is a stderr warning inside a passing test
#256 — correct figma/README.md and pnpm figma:push's output to say which carriers fit use_figma's 50,000-char limit (only 04-role and the snapshot do), then decide chunk-further vs plugin-only

public/hds-manifest.json carries figmaUrl and figmaLink as byte-identical duplicates on all 44 linked components. Dropping one shrinks the published manifest without another budget change, but breaks manifest consumers — needs a call
17 check-tier-bypass violations; recommendation in #242 is 3 semantic families, zIndex named layers first
#249 — gate the record artifacts so status.json and .changeset cannot silently go stale. This file went stale twice in one session, in both directions
Parent epic #196 has two facets left now that #236 is closed: Figma library variable drift (measurable at last) and Figma masters mirroring the rendered components
blocked: FIGMA IS STILL NOT CONSUMABLE BY OTHER DESIGNERS, and the first drift run is the evidence rather than a guess. Dark mode holds Light's values; Role (20 vars), Brand (3) and Density (1) do not exist in Figma at all; 41 of 88 library components have no Figma node; 251 scopes mismatches put variables in the wrong property pickers; 121 hiddenFromPublishing mismatches publish the wrong things to the shared library. AND all of it was measured on the STAGING copy — the published library c8MaVgwxOlxm4wr8wnH0Z4 that consumers actually resolve from has never been snapshotted, so its true state remains unmeasured

Adrian: Code Connect needs a Figma ORGANIZATION plan. On Pro the v2 templates generate and gate locally but cannot publish, so Dev Mode shows no HDS snippets and designers get no code-to-design jump. A plan purchase, not a code problem

Adrian: #254 — API right-sizing (core/pattern/fold, patterns subpath, release targets). Open, needs-decision, default fires 2026-10-03 and the default IS the recommended outcome, so silence resolves it. Its '41 folds' is a DIFFERENT 41 from the 41 missing Figma components

Adrian: #126 — CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN in Actions secrets + CHROMATIC_ENABLED=true in Actions variables. Verified this session that the chromatic job green-SKIPS without it (if: vars.CHROMATIC_ENABLED == 'true'), so a passing chromatic check on any recent PR means NOTHING ran. autoAcceptChanges is already wired for main, so no manual baseline accept is needed once enabled

Adrian: #199 — release held by an org-level policy. GitHub org hirobius -> Settings -> Actions -> General -> Workflow permissions -> Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests. Nothing publishes past 0.13.0 until ticked

Adrian: two community UI kits (Material 3 Design Kit, Simple Design System) are subscribed to the HDS Figma file, so every design-system search returns their components alongside ours. Figma -> Assets panel -> book icon -> toggle both off
gitleaks is not installed locally, so check:secrets skips on every commit. .gitleaks.toml with the HDS token-path allowlists is already committed, so the gate works the moment the binary is on PATH
resolvedThisSession: #236 CLOSED and figma/snapshot.json is on main (PR #258). Proven along the way that no agent can ever take it: the carrier runs fine through use_figma and returns a valid checksum (90bf34df), but use_figma truncates its response at 20 KB while the file is 255 KB — 12.8x — and --ingest checksums the exact bytes. A transport ceiling, not a credential problem. Two earlier failures were misread as transcription error before the runtime was shown to return function source verbatim and all ten functions to transmit byte-perfect; the guard was never at fault. The full DoD, the --json report and where each drift item is tracked are recorded in a closing comment on #236
check:figma-drift IS LIVE ON MAIN and ran against real state for the first time ever. Figures in the headline
#252 answered with the model checked FIRST, as the decision required, because the two branches needed opposite fixes. Stale file, not a model bug

#259 merged — a use_figma carrier now ships only the runtime it reaches. The read-only snapshot no longer carries hdsApply, the code that creates, rewrites and deletes variables: 37,109 -> 6,803 bytes, 25 functions -> 10, checksum covering exactly what runs

#255 merged — the 35-commit guardrail sweep. check:size needed an approved budget re-baseline (47 -> 55 kB; the manifest went 120 -> 139 components) rather than a code change, and that was put to Adrian rather than taken unilaterally after a safety classifier refused it unprompted

#235 CLOSED with the count reconciled: 88 library / 18 slot / 14 layout / 19 internal, libraryMissing 41, so 40 left to draw. The 'stale generatedAt' theory was WRONG — regeneration produced no diff. The 39-vs-41 delta was entirely commit 3f3d51e's three overrides (Frame, OverflowList -> library; Sketch -> internal), flagged in the closing comment so it can be reopened if the integer rather than the rules was what Adrian ratified

/code-review ran before BOTH PRs, as CLAUDE.md mandates, and earned its keep twice. On #255 it found #251 had shipped its implementation with no test though its own DoD demanded one — and writing that test exposed that importing check-link-integrity.mjs ran the whole gate and called process.exit, so the module was not unit-testable at all. On #259 it found the reachableRuntime security property (the snapshot excluding hdsApply) had NO test: the existing suite would have stayed green if the closure silently widened back to the full push engine, because a carrier with too MUCH runtime runs fine and only too LITTLE throws. Both gaps are now pinned by tests

#256 filed — 4 of 5 push carriers exceed use_figma's 50,000-char code limit (01-primitive 76 KB, 02-semantic 100 KB, 03-component 67 KB, 05-styles 55 KB), so the documented agent push path works for 04-role only

#257 filed — Radio's colour animation is silently dead: var(--semantic-*) strings passed to framer-motion's animate prop cannot be interpolated. Survived #239's rewrite unexamined; the file's own JSDoc documents the broken mechanism as intended

Doc-rot fixed twice, both self-inflicted and caught by review rather than shipped: scripts/figma-disposition.mjs told every future reader to go ratify a closed issue, and then its replacement asserted '17 layout primitives' in the present tense while the tool reports 14. It now gives both numbers and says the tool's output beats any count quoted in prose, that comment included

figma/links.json storybookUrl set to https://hirobius-design-system.vercel.app and rebaked, so design-to-code story links point at rendered stories. A previous session left this undone specifically because it could not run the generator

Environment verified end to end and all three inherited environment blockers cleared: pnpm install works (registry.npmjs.org via the default-package-managers option, NOT the Custom allowlist), pnpm figma:inventory --fetch works, the rotated Figma PAT authenticates
